audit_scope: Final data pipeline repository hardening, cleanup, portability, reproducibility, test adequacy, and frozen-artifact invariants; no scientific stage was rerun.
hardening_changes: Removed the obsolete star-expansion compatibility parameter from the production candidate API; complete pair generation is the only production branch below the explicit safety cap.
Reused already-computed band SHA-256 values instead of scanning all band files twice.
Centralized external DOLLMA resolution with AZ_PE_DOLLMA_ROOT precedence and an actionable missing-root error.
Validated staged Parquet row totals before promotion can move a current directory.
Removed unused imports and the unused tqdm requirement; static checks pass when the intentional script bootstrap import pattern is excluded.
Removed the unreferenced one-time postrepair audit generator while preserving its finalized historical Markdown, JSON, and scorecard.
Added path override, missing-root, atomic JSON, and pre-promotion validation regressions.
Quantified the source-level effect of the frozen 50-letter filter and distinguished inventory revalidation date from unknown acquisition date.
Changed two exact-duplicate report references from machine-specific absolute paths to repository-relative paths.

validation_evidence.static_check: PASS with E402 ignored only for deliberate local script bootstrap imports

remaining_findings.description: Per-source revisions and licenses and the original acquisition date are unavailable in local upstream metadata.
remaining_findings.impact: Limits provenance completeness but does not alter corpus identity because shard hashes are frozen.
remaining_findings.recommended_action: Retain explicit unknown values unless authoritative upstream evidence is later obtained.

remaining_findings.description: The frozen 50-letter rule removed 24.00% of mediocore-books rows, more than other sources.
remaining_findings.impact: A documented domain-distribution limitation; changing it now would invalidate frozen artifacts.
remaining_findings.recommended_action: Report the measured source-level removal proportions in methods and limitations.

remaining_findings.description: Connected-component endpoints are not guaranteed pairwise >=0.95; sampled minimum endpoint similarity was 0.819923.
remaining_findings.impact: Documented property of the frozen linkage policy, not an accepted-edge threshold violation.
remaining_findings.recommended_action: Preserve the current disclosure in the handoff, data card, and report.

remaining_findings.description: The frozen YAML retains an unused max_star_band_bucket key as historical configuration state.
remaining_findings.impact: None: production code no longer reads it and the handoff records star=0 and skipped=0.
remaining_findings.recommended_action: Do not change the frozen config hash; omit the key from any future data pipeline configuration version.

portability.condition: Set AZ_PE_DOLLMA_ROOT if the external DOLLMA clone is not at the configured relative path after relocation. M2/M3 consumption of frozen processed artifacts does not need raw DOLLMA.

why_not_100_percent: Upstream per-source provenance gaps are real, the frozen length filter has a documented source-distribution consequence, and connected-component linkage has a known transitivity limitation.
